_comment: Template profile. Copy to <yourcompany>.json, fill in, then set COMPANY_PROFILE=<yourcompany>. Fields: company_name, sector and competitors are required; customer_label defaults to a slug of company_name; sector_themes and segments are optional but strongly recommended — they become targeted searches and are the main driver of extraction quality.
sector: the company's industry, e.g. 'commercial HVAC and building technology'
_sector_themes_note: Industry-wide topics analysts probe across every call in this sector. Searched once, shared across all competitors.
sector_themes: supply chain and input cost inflation
_competitors_note: Each competitor's 'segments' should be their own reporting-segment names as they appear in filings — these cannot be guessed from the company name, and supplying them accurately is what makes the deep-dive searches work.
